data.gender_notes: Iqtedaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iqtedaar is a name derived from the Arabic language. It is a powerful name with spiritual significance in Islam. The name Iqtedaar signifies the One who is constantly sought after or the One who is sought for guidance. It is a name that embodies the idea of seeking knowledge, wisdom, and the path to Allah. The name Iqtedaar carries the meaning “The One Constantly Sought” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iqtedaar usually hope their child will grow to embody the one constantly sought and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Iqtedaar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Constantly Sought.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqtedaar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
